name: openbb_etf_info
description:
Fund facts for one ETF (issuer, inception date, assets under management, expense ratio and more) through the OpenBB Platform (obb.etf.info).
Returns: {tool, data_points (total rows), data: first 100 rows as OpenBB returns them} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): symbol*; provider (OpenBB 4.6 accepts fmp, intrinio or yfinance; schema default fmp, but when omitted the tool sends yfinance).
Yahoo subset: yf_etf_info; holdings: openbb_etf_holdings. Keys: fmp, benzinga, fred, intrinio, polygon and tiingo need credentials in OpenBB's settings (~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json), not supplied by SAJHA; yfinance, oecd, federal_reserve, sec, imf and government_us need none.
Example: {"symbol": "VTI", "provider": "yfinance"}
